description: Permanently delete one specific message. IRREVERSIBLE. The bot can always delete its own messages; deleting another user's message requires the Manage Messages permission. Use discord_bulk_delete_messages to remove many at once. An optional reason is recorded in the audit log.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel or thread containing the message.

message_id.description: ID of the message to delete.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the server audit log.

name: discord_delete_message
